test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. It is because many young people are struggling with stress and anxiety nowadays.
2. Experts suggest that physical exercise and a balanced diet can help alleviate these issues.
3. Mental health has become an important topic of discussion in recent years.
4. The pressure to succeed in academics and career plays a significant role in this struggle.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph is about the topic of mental health, and the sentences need to be arranged logically to form a coherent flow of ideas.
 
• **Sentence 3 is the first sentence** as it introduces the central idea of the paragraph:
 
 
• "Mental health has become an important topic of discussion in recent years."
 
 
 
• S
